title: Devissage of a property of coherent sheaves over the integral closed subschemes of a Noetherian scheme
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], i.e. locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $\mathcal P$ be a property of coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent]. For a sheaf of ideals $\mathcal J\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ and an $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal G$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] let $\mathcal J\mathcal G\subseteq\mathcal G$ be the image of the multiplication map $\mathcal J\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal G\to\mathcal G$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]; stalks $\mathcal G_x$ are as in [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], $\mathfrak m_x\subset\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is the maximal ideal of the local ring [def-weil-residue-field], and $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal G)=\{x\in X:\mathcal G_x\neq0\}$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base](2). Assume: (1) for every short exact sequence $0\to\mathcal F_1\to\mathcal F\to\mathcal F_2\to0$ of coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules, if $\mathcal F_1$ and $\mathcal F_2$ have $\mathcal P$ then so has $\mathcal F$; (2) if $\mathcal F$ is coherent and $\mathcal P$ holds for $\mathcal F^{\oplus r}$ for some $r\ge1$, then $\mathcal P$ holds for $\mathcal F$; (3) for every closed immersion $i:Z\to X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion] with $Z$ an integral scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme] and every point $\xi\in X$ whose closure $\overline{\{\xi\}}$ is $i(Z)$ (the generic point of $Z$), there is a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal G$ such that (a) $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal G)=i(Z)$, (b) $\mathfrak m_\xi\mathcal G_\xi=0$, and (c) for every quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals $\mathcal J\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ with $\mathcal J_\xi=\mathcal O_{X,\xi}$ there is a coherent sub-$\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal G'\subseteq\mathcal J\mathcal G$ with $\mathcal G'_\xi=\mathcal G_\xi$ (as submodules of $\mathcal G_\xi$) such that $\mathcal P$ holds for $\mathcal G'$. Then $\mathcal P$ holds for every coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YM (label lemma-property-higher-rank-cohomological, coherent.tex line 3425); Stacks writes 'quasi-coherent subsheaf G' of JG' in (3)(c), which on the Noetherian X is the same as a coherent one
